investigator.method: Level 1 PASSIVE_STATIC only: plain curl GETs (descriptive User-Agent, no authentication, no browser) of the venue's own official homepage, programme page (/programm/), and two individual event detail pages. The site is WordPress (WPBakery Page Builder) using the 'Offbeat' theme's own built-in event-list widget ('offbeat-event-list-holder') — NOT EventON, Tribe Events Calendar, Fourvenues, or Sanity (confirmed absent by checking the wp-json REST root: only tribe/tickets/v1, wp/v2, and unrelated plugin namespaces are registered — no tribe/events/v1 or any tribe_events post type route exists). The programme list page's own cards show only day+month (no year); each event's own detail page directly states the FULL date ('Datum: August 26, 2026'), time ('Zeit: 20:00 Uhr'), and price ('Eintritt: recommended fee 12€ - 25€') as plain, consistently-labelled static HTML. No structural/browser escalation was needed.

probe_history.reason: A plain curl GET of https://kunstfabrik-schlot.de/programm/ (200 OK, 135,665 bytes) returned a static, theme-native event-list widget with day/month/title/permalink per event. A follow-up curl GET of two independently-selected event detail pages (200 OK) each directly stated the full date, time, and price in a consistently-labelled 'EINZELHEITEN' (Details) block. A check of the site's wp-json REST root (200 OK, 330,506 bytes) confirmed no Events Calendar / Tribe Events REST namespace is registered, ruling out that acquisition path. This directly answers the investigation question at Level 1 — no escalation to Level 2/3 was needed.

venue_reference: Kunstfabrik Schlot (jazz club, Berlin-Mitte — Invalidenstraße 117, in den Edison Höfen, 10115 Berlin)

identity.notes: Official identity confirmed directly from the retained evidence: the site's own footer text states 'Kunstfabrik Schlot, in den Edison Höfen – Invalidenstraße 117 (Zugang auch über Schlegelstraße 26) – 10115 Berlin' — matching the address independently reported by third-party discovery sources (jazz-fun.de, visitBerlin.de, Berlin.de, German Wikipedia) for Kunstfabrik Schlot in Mitte. Domain kunstfabrik-schlot.de is a plausible first-party domain, not a ticketing aggregator.

site_classification.platform: WordPress 6.2 with WPBakery Page Builder and the 'Offbeat' theme (offbeat-event-list-holder / offbeat-event-info-item markup). This is the theme's own built-in event-list feature, not a calendar plugin — confirmed by inspecting the wp-json REST root, which registers only tribe/tickets/v1 (Event Tickets, for ticket sales), wp/v2, and unrelated plugin namespaces; no tribe/events/v1 or tribe_events post type exists. No EventON, Fourvenues, or Sanity signal is present either.

title.value: e.g. 'KOLLEKTIV NIGHTS – DER MOMENT & TAIKO SAITO // CHRIS PITSIOKOS SOLO // VTÍPIL / HANOUSEK / ANDERS / DUBOC' (list page's own <h4 class="edgtf-el-item-title">; matches the detail page's own page title)
title.notes: Directly stated per event on both the list page and the detail page.

start_date.value: each event detail page's own 'Datum:' field, e.g. 'August 26, 2026'
start_date.notes: The FULL date (day, month, AND year) is directly and unambiguously stated as a single field on the event's own detail page ('Datum: August 26, 2026') — no combination of separate context pieces is needed, so this is DIRECT_SOURCE, not DETERMINISTIC_CONTEXT. (The programme LIST page's own cards show only day+month with no year — by itself that would only support PARTIAL/AMBIGUOUS — but the detail page linked from every card directly resolves this.) Confirmed varying correctly across 2 independently-fetched events (August 26, 2026 and August 28, 2026).

time.value: each event detail page's own 'Zeit:' field, e.g. '20:00 Uhr'
time.notes: Directly stated per event. A separate fixed rule is also stated ('Einlass ist eine Stunde vor Programmbeginn' — doors open one hour before the programme start), which is genuinely a general site-wide rule rather than a per-event fact.

end.notes: No end time or end date is present anywhere in the retained list-page or detail-page evidence.

venue_location.notes: Not present per-record on either the list page or the sampled detail pages (the 'EINZELHEITEN' block lists only Eintritt/Datum/Zeit, never a venue name/address). This source resolves to exactly ONE physical venue (Kunstfabrik Schlot, Invalidenstraße 117 — confirmed separately in ev-identity), matching this project's existing Razzmatazz/Jamboree/Quasimodo/b-flat/Zig Zag precedent for a single-venue source that does not restate its own venue name per event.

source_record_id.value: the event's own permalink slug under https://kunstfabrik-schlot.de/event/{slug}/ (e.g. 'jazzkollektiv-berlin-kollektiv-nights', with '-2'/'-3' suffixes disambiguating repeated nights of the same festival series)
source_record_id.notes: No bare numeric id is exposed as its own labelled field, but each event's own href is the site's own permanent WordPress permalink under /event/{slug}/ — the same documented judgement already established for Moog Barcelona, A-Trane, Quasimodo, b-flat, Zig Zag, and LAV (a permalink URL slug the source itself uses as its own canonical path satisfies the stable identifier rule).

event_url.notes: Directly stated as the list card's own <a href>, independently confirmed by fetching both sampled URLs (200 OK, matching content).

price.value: each event detail page's own 'Eintritt:' field, e.g. 'recommended fee 12€ - 25€'
price.notes: Directly stated, an honest 'recommended fee' range rather than a single fixed ticket price — retained as the source's own text, not converted into a fabricated single number. Identical range on both sampled events (both nights of the same festival series), consistent with genuine shared festival pricing rather than a placeholder.

reasons: Identity PROVEN directly from retained evidence (site's own footer address text matching independently reported venue address).
acquisition_class STATIC_HTML, a resolved supported class, retained at Level 1 with no escalation needed (including a direct check ruling out an Events-Calendar/Tribe REST API path).
Two CONFIRMED public data paths retained: the programme list page and representative event detail pages.

title PROVEN with basis DIRECT_SOURCE; start_date PROVEN with basis DIRECT_SOURCE — the event detail page states the FULL date (including year) directly in one field, so no DETERMINISTIC_CONTEXT combination was even needed.
source_record_id PROVEN via the documented URL-slug strategy already established for Moog Barcelona/A-Trane/Quasimodo/b-flat/Zig Zag/LAV.

recommended_family STATIC_EVENT_LIST — an existing collector family this project already documents (list page enumerates events + links; a per-event detail fetch resolves the full date/time/price). No fundamentally new acquisition pattern required.
